caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair centered on a plain, light-colored background. The chair features elaborately carved detailing on the backrest, including scrollwork at the top and a stylized, symmetrical central splat with ornate patterns. The wood grain is rendered with brownish hues, indicating a wood texture. The seat is upholstered and depicted in a dark, almost black shade, suggesting a fabric covering. The chair has four legs, each slightly curved and tapering, with visible wood grain. There are no other objects or decorations in the image. The artist's name, "Edith M. Magreth," is written in small letters at the bottom left of the drawing.
title: Fiddle-back Chair
